decoration_notice.text: The barrels, crates and cupboards of the town hold their owners' goods: look all you like, but they are not yours to open.

happening.text: You stand on the square at the foot of the mountain, the cathedral on one side and the inn on the other.
You reach the quay at the foot of the street.

objectives.hint: Down the main street from the square, past the side streets, to the stone quay at the harbour.
objectives.title: Go down to the harbour

happening.text: The town is walked, square to harbour.
